title: Earthy Juicy Norwegian Peanut Skewers
description: A light and refreshing Norwegian dish featuring peanut brittle and satvik-friendly ingredients, perfect for a snack or dessert. The combination of earthy and juicy flavors creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the firm tofu into small cubes and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the crushed peanut brittle to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Thread a piece of tofu onto each bamboo skewer, leaving a small space at the top.
Brush the peanut brittle mixture onto each piece of tofu.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the tofu is lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers warm and enjoy.
